text:
In you alone, Lesbia, adultery has lost its shame before heaven, since openly and unveiled you have offended noble bones.


By God, you, me, and your husband, do not let earth know your infamy: close the door; sin was born to hide.


I do not say leave your friends, but they should not be noticed by your few enemies.


Your affronted neighbors say the witnesses to your sins delight you more than the sins.

translation.title: To an Adulteress
